content.short: Bidali is a crypto payments platform for gift cards, cash back, merchant payments, and global transfers.
content.description: Bidali is a crypto payments platform that lets users spend digital assets on gift cards, cash-back rewards, merchant payments, and transfers. The product is built around making crypto useful in everyday commerce, especially where direct card or bank access is limited. Businesses can use Bidali to issue digital value, reduce payment friction, and support flexible checkout experiences. For users in the Cardano ecosystem, Bidali represents a payments bridge between blockchain assets and practical purchases.
content.meta: Bidali supports crypto gift cards, cash back, merchant payments, and practical digital commerce. Explore Bidali on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
